description: TSMC Process GNN MAML architecture sweep (11D node features: 7 base + 4 process params)

_comments.voltage_mode_options: all_nodes (voltage on all nodes), vdd_only (voltage only on VDD, 0 elsewhere), vdd_mos (voltage on VDD and MOS transistors only)
_comments.normalization_options: zscore (z-score normalization, default), minmax (min-max to [epsilon, 1] range, 0=placeholder)
_comments.output_node_idx_note: output_node_idx is now dynamically determined from topology cache (fallback default: 2)
_comments.resume_note: Set auto_resume=true to automatically find and continue from latest checkpoint. Set resume to a specific .pth file path. additional_iterations overrides total_iterations when resuming.
_comments.cache_path_note: Path to topology cache file. Only affects adjacency matrix, NOT train data file. Options auto-detected from filename: gatectrl (gate control edges), bidir (bidirectional), directmos (skip intermediate nodes). Example: stage_aware_topology_cache_tsmc_*_gatectrl_directmos.pth
_comments.inputport_note: Set 'inputport': true to use inputport topology. Inputport affects node features, so train file changes to train_cell_stage_aware_inputport.pth
_comments.checkpoint_suffix_note: checkpoint_suffix is auto-generated: cache_suffix (gatectrl/bidir/directmos from cache_path) + topology_suffix (inputport). Example: directmos cache + inputport = checkpoints_directmos_inputport/
_comments.related_pin_only_note: Set 'related_pin_only': true to use dataset with _relpin suffix (input_slew assigned only to related_pin MOS/port). Independent of inputport - works with both topologies.
_comments.loss_logging_note: Set loss_logging.enabled=true to save training loss at specified intervals. log_every controls frequency (iterations). save_dir is optional (defaults to loss_logs/ directory).
